migration_flags.description: product.pricelist.version model does not exist in v19 Community. Was present in v13/v14. Time-based scoping now handled via date_start/date_end on product.pricelist.item records. Migration scripts must transform version records into date-ranged item records.

discount_policy field (values: 'without_discount' / 'discount') on product.pricelist is NOT present in v19 Community. The field controlled whether pricelist discounts absorbed into price_unit or shown as SO line discount. Databases from v14/v15 carrying this field must handle its absence.

property_product_pricelist on res.partner is now a computed field backed by specific_property_product_pricelist (company_dependent=True stored field). Old ir.property records for res.partner.property_product_pricelist may need to be migrated to the new company-dependent field.

key_findings.model_structure: product.pricelist inherits mail.thread+mail.activity.mixin; ordered sequence,id,name; currency_id required defaults to company currency; no discount_policy field in v19
key_findings.item_applied_on: 4 scopes: 3_global, 2_product_category, 1_product, 0_product_variant; numeric prefix encodes sort priority (variant=most specific evaluated first)
key_findings.item_compute_price: 3 methods: fixed (fixed_price field), percentage (percent_price % of base), formula (price_discount % + price_round + price_surcharge + min/max margin clamps)
key_findings.item_base: 3 options: list_price (product.currency_id), standard_price (product.cost_currency_id), pricelist (base_pricelist_id.currency_id with recursive call)
key_findings.rule_sort_order: _order='applied_on, min_quantity desc, categ_id desc, id desc'; first-match semantics in _compute_price_rule loop with break on first applicable rule
key_findings.date_filtering: date_start and date_end are Datetime fields on item; domain uses <= (start) and >= (end) making both bounds inclusive; filtered at ORM query level in _get_applicable_rules
key_findings.currency_conversion: _compute_base_price converts src_currency to pricelist currency via res.currency._convert(price, currency, company, date, round=False) when currencies differ
key_findings.partner_pricelist_assignment: priority: 1) specific_property_product_pricelist (partner-level company-dependent), 2) country group match, 3) ir.config_parameter fallback, 4) first active pricelist; feature gate returns empty if group_product_pricelist disabled
key_findings.pos_integration: pos.config has pricelist_id + available_pricelist_ids + use_pricelist; constraint enforces all available pricelists must share company currency; pos.order carries pricelist_id
key_findings.recursion_guard: DFS constraint _check_pricelist_recursion prevents circular chains when base='pricelist'; unlink guard prevents deleting a pricelist used as base_pricelist_id in other pricelists
key_findings.version_model: product.pricelist.version: DOES NOT EXIST in v19 Community; confirmed by absence of any Python file or class reference across entire addon tree
key_findings.discount_policy: discount_policy: DOES NOT EXIST in v19 Community product_pricelist.py or product_pricelist_item.py; confirmed by grep across all community addons returning no results
